## 💡 Feature Suggestion
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## 🚗 In-Car Dashboard Use Case
Describe how this feature improves the driving or navigation experience on a dashboard-mounted iPad.

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Design
Describe how you envision this feature working. Any mockups, UI concepts, or technical architecture ideas are welcome!

## ⚡ Performance / RAM Considerations
Remember that iPad Mini 1 has 512 MB total RAM and runs iOS 9.3.5. How can this feature stay lightweight (< 25 MB footprint)?

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples here.
